QuestInfo.name: Saving the Townspeople 2
QuestInfo.0: There's trouble with townspeople who got attacked by the kobolds. Talk to #b#p9390450##k.

0.0: Oh, that's right... My son escorted me here, but I don't know where he went...
0.1: Can you keep an eye out? He's probably nearby. You'll recognize him because he's almost as good-looking as I am.

no.0: Fine, leave him if you want. I'll just sit here and munch on fruit.

yes.0: But I have a problem. Want to hear?

npc.0: I wonder where he can be... Can you keep an eye out?
